title: Varanasi Road Widening Project Groundbreaking Ceremony Held
summary: A groundbreaking ceremony was held for the Dalmandi road widening project in Varanasi. MLA Neelkanth Tiwari performed the ceremony. The project is estimated to cost ₹221 crore. The project aims to widen the road in the Dalmandi area.
summary_points: Groundbreaking ceremony held for Dalmandi road widening project in Varanasi.
MLA Neelkanth Tiwari performed the ceremony.
The project is estimated to cost ₹221 crore.
The project involves road widening in the Dalmandi area.
